build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-worker
          path: dist/

e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-worker
          path: dist/
      - run: bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Verify bilingual UX and translation API on the built Worker
        run: bun run test:bilingual
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: bilingual-browser-evidence
          path: /tmp/openodia-bilingual-browser
      - name: Test built Worker API, UX, accessibility and visual regression
        run: bunx playwright test
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/

deploy:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [standards, build, e2e]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run build
      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          command: deploy

crawl:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Crawl events
        id: crawl
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          set +e
          bun run scripts/crawl-events.mjs 2>&1 | tee /tmp/crawl-output.txt
          status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          set -e
          echo "has_changes=$(grep -c 'NEW_EVENTS_FOUND' /tmp/crawl-output.txt || true)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          exit $status
      - name: Create PR if event data changed
        if: (success() || failure()) && steps.crawl.outputs.has_changes != '0'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
          commit-message: "auto: crawl new Odia AI events"
          title: "Odia AI event data updated — $(date +'%b %d')"
          body: |
            Automated crawl found new events or refreshed redirected event destinations.

            Review and merge if the events look correct.
            Source list: https://github.com/soumendrak/openodia-hub/blob/main/.agents/skills/crawl-events/references/sources.md
          branch: auto/crawl-events
          delete-branch: true
